## Core Branded Technologies
- **Cognitive Hypergraph Memory Engine**: Dual-layer memory architecture combining continuous vector embeddings with a Graph Neural Network (GNN) for zero context-loss non-volatile memory graph storage (<15ms recall latency).
- **Autonomous Swarm Matrix**: Multi-agent orchestration engine featuring specialized runtimes (Research Agent, Coding Agent, Strategy Agent, Knowledge Agent, Automation Agent).
- **Sub-15ms Traversal**: Ultra-fast graph traversal and context retrieval across 10M+ neuromorphic synapses.
- **91.4% Token Cost Reduction**: High-efficiency token compression and dynamic context pruning.
